text:
Nora: Quick heads-up 1: embargo window for the launch will be Tue Apr 12 08:00-12:00 PT. We need two analyst briefings + one EU-friendly time. Who can own invites and running the calls?

Ethan: I can run the US calls. Share the analyst list and I'll draft outreach. Also we need a one-line soundbite for press emails.

Sana: Drafting calendar now. Suggest 30-min briefing + 10-15min factcheck buffer. EU slot options: 09:00 BST or 16:00 UTC 1: lean toward 16:00 UTC for APAC overlap.

Nora: Demo + short Q&A in the 30min. Diego, can you present the benchmark summary?

Diego: Yep. Summary numbers for outreach: 24% median p95 latency improvement and ~1.7x per-token cost reduction vs our baseline. I'll paste the short tech appendix here in a moment.

Ava (Legal): Legal note: quote text needs 24h review. No forward-looking claims, and flag any third-party data. Please send final quote to me by Mon EOD for embargo clearance.

Nora: Draft soundbite for review:
"Redwood Inference reduced median p95 latency by 24% and achieved a 1.7x reduction in per-token cost versus our baseline in internal benchmarks."

Ethan: Good start. Two asks: 1) press likes a snappier single sentence (no parentheses); 2) analysts will ask for test harness details and dataset composition 1: include a 2-3 sentence appendix in the factcheck doc.

Sana: Factcheck doc: https://docs.google.com/launch-factcheck-new please add commands, configs, and raw numbers. Deadline for additions Mon 14:00 PT.

Nora: @Ava can you review the soundbite? @Diego please post the appendix here.

Ava (Legal): Please remove "reduced" — use neutral language. Edited quote:
"Redwood Inference demonstrated a 24% median p95 latency improvement and a 1.7x reduction in per-token cost versus our baseline in internal benchmark runs."

Diego: Tech appendix (short): "Benchmarks executed on 4xH100 instances with sequence length 2048, continuous batching enabled, and KV cache active. Workload: mixed conversational plus retrieval prompts; metric: median of p95 latency across 8k samples. Full configs and scripts in the factcheck doc."

Ethan: That appendix works. I'll prepare the outreach email copy with the one-liner + attach the factcheck link. Who's backup presenter if Diego is unavailable?

Sana: Nora can step in for the demo. Recommend recording an internal dry-run and capturing a 90s clip for press to reference. :film_projector:

Nora: I can host a dry-run tomorrow at 10:00 PT. Please RSVP here if you want to attend: Ethan, Diego, Ava.

Diego: RSVP yes for dry-run.

Ava (Legal): I'll join for quote sign-off at the dry-run. FYI: flag any vendor model or third-party benchmarks in the doc.

Ethan: Analyst slots plan: US 08:30 & 10:00 PT, EU 16:00 UTC. Each 30min + 15min buffer for quick fact-checking. Embargo reiterated Apr 12 08:00-12:00 PT.

Sana: Booking invites now, toggling recording off by default. Adding conference link + dial-in.

Nora: Final task list:
- Ethan: analyst invites + outreach copy + single-sentence soundbite
- Diego: paste raw benchmark logs & confirm numbers in factcheck doc
- Ava: legal clearance of final quote by Mon EOD
- Sana: calendar invites + dry-run recording setup

All: add any missing technical notes or dataset provenance to the factcheck doc before Mon 14:00 PT. :thumbsup:
